author: Swinhoe, 1871
summary: 겨울철새이지만 일부는 서해안에서 번식하며, 갯벌이 있는 해안과 강 하구에서 무리 지어 산다. 보통 수십 마리가 한 무리를 이루고, 크게 모일 때는 수백 마리 단위로 움직인다. 갯벌 위를 낮고 느리게 날다가 내리꽂혀 게나 갯지렁이를 잡거나, 갯벌을 걸어 다니며 먹이를 찾는다. 알은 2~3개를 낳으며, 국내에서는 서남해안에 살고 국외에서는 중국 동북부 해안에 분포한다.

sexes.text: 암수 생김새로는 가려내기 어렵고, 수컷이 암컷보다 조금 크다.

young: 어린새는 윗면이 갈색이고 깃 가장자리가 옅은 색이다.

art.subject: Saunders's Gull (Saundersilarus saundersi), adult in breeding plumage as seen on Korean west-coast mudflats from March to June: jet-black hood covering the head and upper throat, with bold white crescents above and below the eye forming a broken white eye-ring; neck, underparts and tail white; mantle and wing coverts pearl-grey; folded wingtips black with white tips; outer primaries largely white with small black subterminal marks. Bill short, stubby and black; dark eye; legs dark red.
art.pose: flying low and slowly over a mudflat, about to drop onto a crab
art.scene: Korean west-coast tidal mudflat at a river mouth in spring; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage (March–June), side view standing: black hood with white crescents above and below the eye, short stubby black bill, pearl-grey back and wings, black-and-white wingtips, white neck, underparts and tail, dark red legs
adult non-breeding plumage, head close-up in side view: white head with a dark spot behind the eye and a dusky smudge over the rear crown, white eye crescents, short black bill
juvenile, side view standing: brown upperparts with paler buff feather edges, dark spot behind the eye, white underparts, black tail band
adult in flight seen from below: white body and tail, mostly white outer primaries, and a distinct black wedge on the underside of the inner primaries
art.build: Small, compact gull, 29–32cm, clearly smaller than a Black-tailed Gull and a little smaller than a Black-headed Gull, with a rounded head and a short, thick, blunt black bill much shorter than the head. Legs short, dark red. At rest the wingtips extend beyond the tail. Flight light and tern-like; it often hovers low over the mud and drops onto crabs. In flight the upperwing is grey with whitish outer primaries tipped with small black marks, and from below it shows a black wedge on the inner primaries.
avoid: Do not paint a long, slender red bill — that is Black-headed Gull; Saunders's bill is short, stubby and black.
Do not paint a chocolate-brown hood; the hood is jet black.
Do not paint large solid black wingtips like a Black-tailed Gull's; the outer primaries are mostly white with small black marks.
Do not make it large or long-legged; it is a small, compact gull.
